passes.purpose: Validate applicability, explicit probe coverage, and execution readiness
passes.question: Can this workflow run now?

authoring_passes.rule: When authoring or modifying workflows, run both check and review. Neither replaces the other.

commands.definition: Public launch command for discovering playbook workflows and running one named workflow in a selected runtime mode.

discovery_commands.name: workflows list
discovery_commands.summary: list declared playbook workflows with project-local descriptions

discovery_commands.name: workflows show <workflow>
discovery_commands.summary: show one workflow entry with file metadata, playbook-owned invocation inputs, and root-declared inputs

do_not_use_for: Teaching workflow-body semantics that belong to workflow, playbook, or workflow-authoring discovery surfaces.
Treating check as complete workflow sign-off; review is still required for authoring-quality findings.
Encoding durable project logic in launch flags instead of declared workflow inputs, playbook metadata, or workflow structure.

flags.name: --file
flags.summary: Use one explicit playbook file path

flags.name: --profile
flags.summary: Select one named profile for this run

flags.name: --input
flags.summary: Add or override one top-level workflow input from inline text, with simple number and true/false coercion

flags.name: --input-file
flags.summary: Add or override one top-level workflow input from a raw UTF-8 file string

input_override_precedence: workflow.inputs declares the allowed activation keys; declared keys are required at activation=true
profile.inputs may supply values for declared workflow inputs
playbook workflow-entry with supplies static invocation inputs before one run
playbook pre_run with supplies static invocation inputs to that pre_run workflow only
--input overrides workflow and profile-provided values for one run
--input-file overrides workflow and profile-provided values for one run
when both --input and --input-file set the same key, --input-file wins

modes.name: review <workflow>
modes.summary: review authoring-quality findings without making changes

modes.name: check <workflow>
modes.summary: check whether the workflow can be run now, without making changes

modes.name: plan <workflow>
modes.summary: show what the workflow would do, without making changes

modes.name: explain <workflow>
modes.summary: explain why the workflow can or cannot be run right now

modes.name: run <workflow>
modes.summary: run the workflow and do the real work

modes.name: next <workflow>
modes.summary: suggest the next workflow step to run now

commands.name: ordo-playbook

nearest_surfaces.summary: Top-level catalog of public launch commands and stable flags
Playbook workflow-entry field that binds one published workflow name to one workflow file
Why check and review are complementary authoring passes rather than substitutes

commands.purpose: Browse playbook workflows or launch one named workflow into one runtime mode

run_failure_surface.rule: When a run failure has normalized external context, the public failure payload should identify that external cause instead of surfacing only a generic wrapper message.

commands.run_success_surface: successful run emits workflow-local results, may also surface global published values, and may synthesize one top-level fallback result when neither results nor published output were produced
use_when: You need to discover which named workflows the current playbook publishes before choosing one.
You need to run one workflow through check, review, plan, explain, run, or next.
You need one-run launch overrides such as --profile, --input, or --input-file without editing the workflow or playbook.
